description:
A free batch photo/image resizer tool

Fotosizer is a free batch photo/image resizer tool. It lets you resize hundreds of photos in a matter of minutes in a quick and easy way.
- Fixed File Not Found error when clicking view output folder button.
- Fixed File Not Found error when using the Add folder button and it finding a file that does not meet filters choices.
- Fixed Fotosizer Windows explorer context menu integration so that it uses HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE registry key as a fallback to find the Fotosizer installation folder.
- Fixed Start menu program group folder not being created during setup.
- Fixed DPI display issue on file override dialog.
- Added saving of last used profile name.
- Added pre-filling of new profile title from currently selected profile.
- Fixed saving of profiles so the ordering is maintained instead of adding to the bottom of the list of profiles.
- Fixed copying of EXIF metadata to include Lens make and Lens model.
- Added copying of XMP metadata.
